name: PPC On Hold Jobs Report
query:
SELECT
  jc.name AS `Job Card:Link/Job Card Computer Paper:160`,
  jc.customer AS `Customer:Data:200`,
  jc.specification_name AS `Specification:Data:200`,
  jc.hold_reason AS `Hold Reason:Data:160`,
  jc.hold_remarks AS `Remarks:Data:240`,
  jc.hold_by AS `Hold By:Link/User:140`,
  jc.hold_on AS `Hold On:Datetime:160`,
  jc.hold_previous_status AS `Previous Status:Data:140`,
  jc.due_date AS `Due:Date:100`
FROM `tabJob Card Computer Paper` jc
WHERE jc.docstatus < 2
  AND jc.job_status = 'On Hold'
ORDER BY jc.hold_on DESC
